text:
maria.pm: Quick sync — we need a short decision on which two model variants to admit for next onboard wave. Customers asking for lower cost options but SRE wants predictable latency. Can each owner chip in RICE-ish numbers and a short note by EOD?

ajay.eng: Fwiw cost delta: LlamaX-2 (fp16) ~2.2x token cost vs our baseline, Mistral-Dev (int8) ~1.1x. Latency: LlamaX-2 80–120ms p50 on 8k context, Mistral-Dev 40–60ms.

caroline.ml: Quality signals: on our eval suite Mistral-Dev beats baseline on instruction-following (+7% instrF1) but hallucination risk slightly higher on long math prompts. LlamaX-2 has strong factuality but struggles with instruction style tuning unless we use additional SFT.

ben.cs: Customer asks: two existing pilot customers explicitly requested a smaller-cost variant for embeddings and low-compute summarization — they mentioned Mistral family by name. One enterprise asked for Llama-family for legal summarization due to perceived factuality.

kevin.prodops: Operational constraints: Dedicated pools are booked next quarter; adding a high-memory LlamaX-2 variant increases reserved capacity needs. Also we need rollout gates: canary at 1% traffic, QA eval set pass >=95% on regressions, auto-fallback to baseline on >2x error rate.

maria.pm: To keep this actionable, propose we score on a 0-10 for Reach, Impact, Confidence, and estimate Effort in dev-weeks. I'll collect numbers and we can sum R*I*C / Effort. Short example below — paste your numbers.

ajay.eng: My quick numbers: Reach 6, Impact 7, Confidence 6, Effort 4w -> RICE = (6*7*6)/4 = 63

caroline.ml: Mistral-Dev: Reach 8, Impact 6, Confidence 7, Effort 2w -> RICE = (8*6*7)/2 = 168

ben.cs: LlamaX-2 customer demand: Reach 4, Impact 8, Confidence 5, Effort 6w -> RICE = (4*8*5)/6 = 26.6

kevin.prodops: Operational penalty: add multiplier 0.7 for variants that increase reserved GPU footprint >1.5x. Applies to LlamaX-2. After op-penalty LlamaX-2 adjusted ~18.6.

squad-bot: deploy-scheduler: Next free canary slot for model wave: 2026-04-08 -> assign if team approves.

maria.pm: Synthesizing: Mistral-Dev is high RICE and low effort; aligned with customer asks for lower cost. Recommend Mistral-Dev admitted in wave 1 (canary -> scaled rollouts). LlamaX-2 is a niche but high-effort option; recommend follow-on exploration with benchmark SLA and a mini-PoC with the customer who requested it.

ajay.eng: Agree. I'll draft a minimal serve config for Mistral-Dev (int8) and include KV cache tuning + a suggested batching profile.

caroline.ml: I'll prepare the eval prompt set, include long-form math and legal summarization checks, and flag hallucination regression detection thresholds.

kevin.prodops: I'll block the canary slot and draft rollout playbook (fallback, throttles, observability). Ops note: we need to ensure quantized model has per-token cost metrics instrumented.

maria.pm: Decision: Mistral-Dev admitted for next wave; LlamaX-2 deferred to research queue pending dedicated capacity and SFT plan. Action items: ajay -> serve config (PR), caroline -> eval set, kevin -> rollout playbook, ben -> confirm pilot customer availability. We'll reconvene after PR + eval run. Thanks :thumbsup:
